title: Help Each Other
simplified_paragraphs: 我是一个留学生，在北京学习汉语。现在我想找一份工作，不知道留学生可不可以打工。我学过怎么教英语。所以我的朋友说，可以找一个中国学生，我教他英语，他教我汉语。我们可以互相帮助，还可以认识新的朋友。我觉得这个主意非常好。
traditional_paragraphs: 我是一個留學生，在北京學習漢語。現在我想找一份工作，不知道留學生可不可以打工。我學過怎麼教英語。所以我的朋友說，可以找一個中國學生，我教他英語，他教我漢語。我們可以互相幫助，還可以認識新的朋友。我覺得這個主意非常好。
pinyin_paragraphs: wǒ shì yī gè liú xué shēng， zài Běi jīng xué xí Hàn yǔ。 xiàn zài wǒ xiǎng zhǎo yī fèn gōng zuò， bù zhī dào liú xué shēng kě bù kě yǐ dǎ gōng。 wǒ xué guo zěn me jiāo Yīng yǔ。 suǒ yǐ wǒ de péng you shuō， kě yǐ zhǎo yī gè Zhōng guó xué shēng， wǒ jiāo tā Yīng yǔ， tā jiāo wǒ Hàn yǔ。 wǒ men kě yǐ hù xiāng bāng zhù， hái kě yǐ rèn shi xīn de péng you。 wǒ jué de zhè gè zhǔ yi fēi cháng hǎo。
english_paragraphs: I’m an international student studying Chinese in Beijing. Now I want to find a job, but I don’t know whether international students are allowed to work. I’ve learned how to teach English, so my friend suggested finding a Chinese student: I could teach them English, and they could teach me Chinese. We could help each other and make new friends, too. I think it’s a great idea.
english_full: I’m an international student studying Chinese in Beijing. Now I want to find a job, but I don’t know whether international students are allowed to work. I’ve learned how to teach English, so my friend suggested finding a Chinese student: I could teach them English, and they could teach me Chinese. We could help each other and make new friends, too. I think it’s a great idea.
